caveats: the gate arm is the declared intervention at its open values — no move cost, no transit loss, both unmet-ratio lines at zero — so its cohorts move every month: 179769 cumulative household-moves against 50400 households that started, and 23349 out-of-region exits. The movers figure is a flow over 240 months and not a count of distinct households

an in-region move abandons land at the origin and the receiving cohort gains none — `receive_migrant_households` carries households, adults, grain, silver and assets, and no land — so repeated moves erode the assessable base further than the population that left would suggest. The direction of the contrast is not in doubt; its size is a property of those two declarations
the gate arm's assessable base ends at 2917 mu against 433800 at the start, a contraction of 0.9933
